name: Fincome
description:
Fincome reveals untapped growth levers at the heart of your revenue data to fuel your strategic decisions.

SEE
A seamless view of all your data & KPIs
All your KPIs and dashboards, computed by the Data Engine and accessible in one click: no training, no data analyst needed.

UNDERSTAND
Unmatched analytical depth
Dive into every figure. Cross-reference your segments, cohorts, and breakdowns by geography, product, and acquisition channel to understand precisely how your revenue is evolving.

DECIDE
Custom reports, forecasting, and stronger collaboration
Anticipate variances to plan, model your trade-offs, and share your analyses: your teams discuss, iterate, and decide within Fincome.

Fincome is a revenue analytics platform for B2B SaaS vendors. The connector gives Claude secure, read-only access to the subscription metrics Fincome computes from the company's billing data (Stripe, Chargebee, NetSuite, Pennylane, etc.), ARR/MRR, growth bridges, churn, net and gross revenue retention, cohorts, ARPA/ACV, LTV/CAC, quick ratio, as well as row-level views such as invoices, subscriptions, and MRR by customer.

Primary tasks users accomplish:
1. Instant reporting in natural language: query any SaaS metric, broken down by product, country, plan, or the company's custom dimensions...
2. Retention and churn analysis: investigate churn and NRR/GRR trends, then drill into row-level data to identify which customers or segments drive a movement.
3. Board and investor reporting: assemble ARR bridges, KPI summaries, and commentary for board decks and investor updates.
4. Financial due diligence: produce structured financial datapacks (ARR bridges, cohort retention, customer concentration) during fundraising or M&A processes.
5. Ad hoc analysis: answer bespoke questions combining metrics and views: pricing and ACV trends, expansion vs. new business mix, segment performance.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Fincome to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Fincome to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.fincome.co/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Fincome MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Fincome provides these MCP tools: describe_metric, describe_view, get_company_settings, get_metric, list_metrics, list_sources, list_views, and query_view.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Fincome?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Fincome in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Fincome requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Fincome is developed by Fincome. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
